platform: Sinusoidal Music Direct Editorial Submission Form
manual_review_reason: Sinusoidal Music explicitly directs artists to its first-party Music Submissions/contact page and promotes the form as a route for song or album coverage, but the complete form fields, consent language, asset requirements and runtime challenge state are not exposed in passive retrieval. A human must inspect the live form, distinguish the direct editorial route from paid Meta ads, playlist and Musosoup options, confirm track and genre fit, review any promotional-disclosure or rights language, and approve all artist data, links and final submission. No public email should be guessed or used as a substitute.
